title: Hedgehog

source.title: Hedgehog – Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

excerpt.text: There are hedgehogs in Europe, Asia, Africa, and New Zealand.
Hedgehogs eat insects, snails, frogs and toads, snakes, bird eggs, carrion, mushrooms, berries and melons.
Sometimes, hedgehogs will search for earthworms after rainstorms.
Hedgehogs are nocturnal animals and they hibernate between November and March.
Hedgehogs have long spines, or quills, made of keratin.
They do not come off easily, unlike porcupines, but in baby hedgehogs, the baby quills drop off and are replaced with adult quills.
When they are very stressed or sick, their quills can fall off, too.
African pygmy hedgehogs are the most common type that are kept as pets.
Hedgehogs are exotic pets, which means they may not be legal to keep as pets in some places.
